@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import gc
 import os
 import sys
 from io import BytesIO
@@ -7,6 +8,65 @@ import pytest
 import click
 from click.exceptions import ClickException
 from click.testing import CliRunner
+from click.testing import _NamedTextIOWrapper
+
+
+def test_named_text_wrapper_does_not_close_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<first>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<second>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.close()
+    first.close()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+
+    second.write("second")
+    second.close()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecond"
+
+    finalized = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<finalized>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    finalized.write("finalized")
+    del finalized
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecondfinalized"
+
+
+def test_isolation_does_not_close_output_buffers(runner):
+    with runner.isolation() as streams:
+        click.echo("stdout")
+        click.echo("stderr", err=True)
+
+    stdout, stderr, output = streams
+
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == b"stdout\n"
+    assert stderr.getvalue() == b"stderr\n"
+    assert output.getvalue() == b"stdout\nstderr\n"
+
+
+def test_invoke_restores_streams_after_exception(runner):
+    original_streams = sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr
+
+    @click.command()
+    def fail():
+        click.echo("before failure")
+        raise RuntimeError("failure")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="failure"):
+        runner.invoke(fail, catch_exceptions=False)
+
+    assert (sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr) == original_streams
+
+    result = runner.invoke(fail)
+
+    assert isinstance(result.exception, RuntimeError)
+    assert result.output == "before failure\n"
+    assert (sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr) == original_streams
